svg.title: 06. Standing front hip stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Take a short split stance. Raise the back heel. Bend both knees a little and tighten the back buttock. Tuck your pelvis slightly and move your hips forwards.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/blob/main/exercises/Standing_Hip_Flexors.json
